Corrections

    Setting up the shot
    • Prop the phone at hip height, 2–3 m away, with you head to feet in frame.
    • Record a clip and hold the pose: Sama times how long you stay in line.
    • Practise barefoot with hands uncovered: Sama checks foot direction, heel line and wrist and palm position too.
    • Fitted clothes and an uncluttered background give steadier readings.

          The coach only reads text: your answers, your scores and the corrections Sama found. Photos and clips never leave your device.

          Sign in to use the coach

          The coach and Sama Help run on an AI model, so they are for people signed in to Sama. Signing in is free and also keeps your practice on all your devices.

          What you told me

            Answer a few questions and three practices will appear here, each scored by an independent judge.

            How is my alignment going?

            The coach reads your recent checks (scores, hold times and the corrections Sama gave) and tells you what is working, what to fix first, and what to practise next.

            Review a routine

            Paste a sequence you practise, or pick a saved practice, say what it is for, and get a critique with a corrected version.

            Yoga studios near you

            Yoga is also a community. Find a studio close by, practise with others, and book a class with ClassPass or Urban Sports Club.

            Your location is used only for this search. It goes to OpenStreetMap to find the studios and is not saved.

            Teach yoga or run a studio? Add your class so people nearby can find it in Sama.

            Sign in to add your class. It is linked to your account, so only you can change or remove it.

                      Movement recordings

                        What the app checks

                          Report a problem

                          Tell us what looks off. It goes straight to the pose review, together with the view you were looking at.

                          Sama help

                          Send to the Sama team

                          Your message and this conversation go to the person who makes Sama, with your device type and app version so they can help.

                          Add your class

                          People using Sama near this place will see it. Only you can change or remove it.

                          Days

                          Did you know?

                          Put Sama on your home screen

                          It opens full-screen like an app. Nothing to download: it is this website, always up to date.

                            Choose a pose

                            Watch on your TV

                            This browser cannot cast on its own, so use one of these:

                            1. Mirror your screen. Cast or mirror your phone's screen to the TV (Android: Cast / Smart View in Quick Settings; iPhone: Screen Mirroring in Control Centre).

                              The TV layout keeps the camera and the timer, with the reference figure large. Tap Exit TV layout to come back.

                            2. Open the link on the TV. In the TV's browser (or a laptop plugged into the TV) open this link; your practice is inside it.
